title: Why orchestration beats automation every time
excerpt: Point automation solves one problem. Orchestration removes a category of problems. Here is the difference and why it matters for your firm.

children.text: Point automation solves one problem in isolation. It can save time in one step, but it rarely changes how the full workflow behaves.
Orchestration approaches the system end to end. It connects intake, handoff, follow-up, and reporting so the work moves as one process instead of disconnected tasks.
For professional service firms, that difference matters. You are not just automating actions; you are creating operating leverage that compounds over time.
